# GroundTruth MCP Server

> Self-hosted MCP server for live documentation, best practices, and code audits. Routes plain-text queries ("use gt mcp") to the right tool. Runs locally, no rate limits. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Desktop.

GroundTruth is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that fetches documentation from official sources at query time. It tries llms.txt first, then Jina Reader for JS-rendered pages, then GitHub. It covers 445+ curated libraries and falls back to npm, PyPI, crates.io, and pkg.go.dev for any public package. Unlike cloud-hosted documentation tools, GroundTruth runs on your machine. No rate limits. No API keys.

v7.4.1 adds a dispatch tool for plain-text intent routing, per-tool telemetry, an SSRF-hardened multi-source fetcher, atomic disk cache writes, and Unicode-homoglyph injection defenses.

## Install

One command for Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add gt -- npx -y @groundtruth-mcp/gt-mcp@latest
```

For Cursor, VS Code, or Claude Desktop, add to your MCP config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gt": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@groundtruth-mcp/gt-mcp@latest"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Tools (14)

- gt_dispatch. Routes a plain-text query to the right tool. Use it when the intent is ambiguous ("use gt mcp").
- gt_resolve_library. Looks up a library name in the registry, then falls back to npm, PyPI, crates.io, and Go. Call this before gt_get_docs.
- gt_get_docs. Fetches docs for a library. Optional topic filter, lockfile-aware version detection.
- gt_best_practices. Patterns, anti-patterns, and config guidance for one library.
- gt_auto_scan. Reads dependency manifests, detects lockfile versions, fetches best practices for every dep.
- gt_search. Freeform search across OWASP, MDN, web.dev, W3C, AI provider docs. No library name required.
- gt_audit. Scans source files. Returns issues at file:line with fixes from official specs.
- gt_changelog. Recent release notes. Read this before upgrading.
- gt_compat. Browser and runtime compatibility from MDN and caniuse.
- gt_compare. Side-by-side comparison of two or three libraries.
- gt_examples. GitHub usage examples for a library plus a pattern.
- gt_migration. Migration guides, breaking changes, upgrade steps between versions.
- gt_batch_resolve. Up to 20 names in one call.
- gt_snippets. Pre-indexed code snippets per library and version. Context7-compatible.

## Trigger phrases

- "use gt" / "use gt mcp": gt_auto_scan on the current project.
- "use gt for X" or a library name: gt_resolve_library, then gt_best_practices.
- "find issues" / "audit": gt_audit.
- "migrate X from N to M": gt_migration.
- "what's new in X": gt_changelog.
- "compare X vs Y": gt_compare.
- "browser support for Y": gt_compat.
- A pasted URL: gt_get_docs.

## Key facts

- Package: @groundtruth-mcp/gt-mcp on npm.
- License: Elastic License 2.0.
- Node.js 24 or later.
- 445+ curated libraries, plus unlimited ecosystem fallbacks.
- 100+ code audit patterns across 9 categories.
- 1083 tests across 41 files.
- Self-hosted. No cloud dependency. No rate limits.
- Fetches from llms.txt, Jina Reader, GitHub, npm, PyPI, crates.io, pkg.go.dev.
- Content integrity hashing (SHA-256) on every fetched document.
- Lockfile version detection for targeted retrieval.
- SSRF guard blocks RFC1918, loopback, link-local, ULA, and full-form IPv6 bypass attempts.
- Injection guard strips zero-width and RTL-override chars and handles homoglyph variants.
- Disk cache writes are atomic, with per-key locks. Crash-safe.
- Per-tool telemetry: p50, p95, success rate, resolve rate. Exposed at /health.
- Context7 alternative with broader coverage, code auditing, and a dispatch entry point.

## Supported ecosystems

- JavaScript / TypeScript: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Node.js, Bun, Deno, Fastify, NestJS, Hono.
- Python: FastAPI, Django, Flask, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, SQLAlchemy.
- Rust: Axum, Actix Web, Tokio, sqlx, serde, clap, anyhow, thiserror, tonic.
- Go: Gin, Fiber, GORM, chi, Cobra, Zap, sqlc, Bubble Tea.
- AI / LLM: Claude API, OpenAI Agents SDK, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, Google ADK, Open WebUI.
- Databases: Prisma, Drizzle, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.
- Testing: Vitest, Playwright, Jest, Cypress.
- Cloud: Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, Firebase, Google Cloud.
- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, OpenTelemetry.
